evidence: The top-level statements `new UuidGenerator()`, `new SystemClock()` and `new InMemory*Repository()` set up adapters, which is infrastructure work.
`createApp({ users: new UserService(...), projects: new ProjectService(...), tasks: new TaskService(...) })` is dependency wiring in the composition root.
`Number(process.env.PORT ?? 3000)` reads runtime configuration from the environment.
`app.listen(port, ...)` with `console.log` starts the transport and logs that it is listening.
parsedVerdict.reasoning: src/infrastructure/server.ts is the composition root and process entry point. It creates the infrastructure adapters (UuidGenerator, SystemClock and the in-memory repositories) and passes them into the application services. It then builds the HTTP app, reads PORT from the environment and starts listening. Wiring, configuration and starting the server are all framework and runtime work, which belongs in the infrastructure layer. The file has no business rules, validation or domain decisions. The port fallback to 3000 is runtime configuration, not business logic.
